questions.title: Number Sign Checker
questions.description: Write a Java program that checks if a number is positive, negative, or zero. Use the number -5 in your code. Print an appropriate message based on the number's sign.
constraints: Check for all three cases: positive, negative, zero

questions.title: Grade Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program that converts a numeric score (use 85) to a letter grade. Use the standard grading scale: A (90-100), B (80-89), C (70-79), D (60-69), F (below 60).
constraints: Use nested if-else or else-if chain
Display both score and letter grade
hints: Work your way down through each grade range
Use else for the failing grade

questions.title: Leap Year Checker
questions.description: Write a Java program that determines if a year is a leap year. Use the year 2024. A year is a leap year if: (1) it's divisible by 4 AND not divisible by 100, OR (2) it's divisible by 400. Use logical operators (&&, ||).
constraints: Implement the complete leap year rule
Display whether the year is a leap year or not
hints: 2024 % 4 == 0 and 2024 % 100 != 0, so it's a leap year

questions.title: Day of Week Switch
questions.description: Write a Java program that uses a switch statement to print the name of a day based on a number (1-7). Use day = 3. Also handle invalid day numbers with a default case.
constraints: Include a default case for invalid input

questions.title: Triangle Validator
questions.description: Write a Java program that checks if three given side lengths can form a valid triangle. Use sides: a=3, b=4, c=5. A valid triangle requires that the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third side. Also determine if it's equilateral, isosceles, or scalene.
constraints: Use logical operators for validity check
Classify the triangle type if valid

examples.output:
Sides: 3, 4, 5
Valid triangle: Yes
Type: Scalene
